title: E-QTM-0152: teleportation and entanglement swapping on the knit: the pair a love and a fear make at one meeting from...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0152 in the quantum arena: teleportation and entanglement swapping on the knit: the pair a love and a fear make at one meeting from a common role point is maximally entangled and a stabilizer state, and with it, a reading of two roles on a Lagrangian coset (two classical trits, each outcome at chance 1/9) and one link move per outcome, every input reaches the receiving role exactly on all 17 link starts, fears included, and half of a fear-carrying knot swaps onto a role that never met its partner; with the fear beat off the pair is a product, and a like pair, an ebit at best, teleports no qutrit.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
